scenario: [LTIM.14.1] with [LEXP.17.1]: `calendar.time` takes 3, 6 or 7 fields, a set and not a range, so `calendar.time(2026, 1, 1, 12)` is DS_VALIDATE_BAD_ARITY. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.lgra_9_8_11_builtin_call` over [LEXP.17.2]'s `calendar.time` row, `[3, 6, 7]`, in `dsc.builtin_fns`.
rules_ds:
import calendar

schema Ev scope logical:
    id: Int key
    t: Time mutable

rule late:
    Ev e where e.t > calendar.time(2026, 1, 1, 12)
->
    log info "late {e.id}"
